description: Sprint 12: Signal feed UI, dashboard API hygiene, SPY walk-forward validation, rolling WFE monitoring, Schwab OAuth, security P0 key rotation, broker position reconciliation, and performance analytics expansion.

userStories.title: Real-time signal feed on /command-center
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a live signal feed widget on the command center so I can see the most recent trading decisions from the pipeline without navigating away.
acceptance_criteria: dashboard/app/command-center/ contains SignalFeedWidget component polling GET /api/v1/decisions/recent every 30 seconds via fetchEngine
Each row displays: symbol, direction badge (LONG=green, SHORT=red, HOLD=gray), conviction score (0-100), ISO timestamp, and R:R ratio
Widget renders in Iron Man HUD dark terminal aesthetic — dark background, monospace font, colored badges, subtle scan-line or glow effect
Widget gracefully shows empty state when no recent decisions exist
Widget shows last-updated timestamp and a loading/error state if the endpoint is unreachable
cd dashboard && pnpm run build passes with 0 TypeScript errors after adding component

userStories.title: Fix hardcoded localhost:8010 in dashboard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all dashboard API calls to go exclusively through fetchEngine/postEngine so that environment-based API routing works correctly and no hardcoded URLs exist.
acceptance_criteria: grep -r 'localhost:8010' dashboard/app dashboard/components dashboard/lib --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' returns zero matches
grep -r 'localhost:8010' dashboard/app dashboard/components dashboard/lib --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' returns zero matches (verified by CI grep step)
All identified hardcoded fetch calls replaced with fetchEngine or postEngine from lib/api.ts
cd dashboard && pnpm run build passes with 0 TypeScript errors after replacements
No new direct fetch calls to port 8010 introduced — enforced by grep check in pre-commit hook or CI

userStories.title: SPY 1h walk-forward validation
userStories.description: As a quant, I want SPY 1h to be formally evaluated with our walk-forward framework so its status can be set to APPROVED or NOT APPROVED based on objective WFE data.
acceptance_criteria: Walk-forward run executed: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m backtest.walk_forward --symbol SPY --interval 1h --train-months 6 --test-months 3
Results stored in engine/data/wfe_results/SPY_1h.json containing: symbol, interval, wfe, windows_run, window_details, run_date
If WFE >= 0.50: engine/backtest/signals.py INSTRUMENT_PARAMS updated to include SPY 1h entry with STC_OS=15, STC_OB=88, stop=0.30, t1=1.00, wfe=<actual>, status=APPROVED
If WFE < 0.50: engine/data/wfe_results/SPY_1h.json status field set to NOT_APPROVED with reason documented
MEMORY.md SPY 1h row updated from 'TBD / PENDING WF' to actual WFE value and final status
cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v shows no regressions from any signals.py changes

userStories.title: Rolling WFE monitoring endpoint
userStories.description: As a trader, I want an API endpoint that returns the current WFE for each instrument, when it was last calculated, and when it is next due, so I can ensure strategy validity is continuously monitored.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/instruments/wfe-status returns JSON array with one entry per approved instrument: { symbol, interval, wfe, status, last_calculated, next_due, alert }
next_due is calculated as last_calculated + 28 days (4-week rolling recalculation cycle)
alert field is true when wfe < 0.40 OR when next_due is within 3 days of today
Endpoint is backed by engine/data/wfe_cache.json — file is created/updated whenever a walk-forward run completes
engine/routers/instruments_router.py contains the endpoint and is registered in main.py
cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with no regressions

userStories.title: Schwab OAuth activation
userStories.description: As a trader, I want the Schwab connector to complete an OAuth browser flow so that the system can authenticate with Schwab's API and the connection status is visible in the engine.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/schwab/status returns JSON: { connected: bool, token_expires_at: str|null, scopes: list|null, error: str|null }
POST /api/v1/schwab/connect triggers the OAuth browser flow at developer.schwab.com and returns { auth_url: str } for the client to open
On successful OAuth callback, engine/data/.schwab_token.json is created and persists across restarts
engine/execution/schwab_connector.py reads .schwab_token.json on startup and sets SCHWAB_READY=True when token is valid
engine/routers/schwab_router.py contains both endpoints and is registered in main.py
SCHWAB_READY remains False and no orders are routed to Schwab until live trading phase — safety invariant unmodified

userStories.title: Security P0 — API key rotation
userStories.description: As a system owner, I want all potentially exposed API keys to be revoked and regenerated so that no unauthorized access to third-party services is possible from historical exposure.
acceptance_criteria: Anthropic API key revoked at console.anthropic.com and new key generated
Polygon API key revoked at polygon.io dashboard and new key generated
Twilio auth token regenerated at console.twilio.com
Google OAuth client secret regenerated at console.cloud.google.com
engine/.env updated with all four new credentials
cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8010 starts clean with no authentication errors in logs
bash scripts/hooks/check-secrets.sh returns 0 new findings — .secrets.baseline updated if needed
All new keys confirmed absent from git history (git log --all -S '<key_prefix>' returns no matches)

userStories.title: Broker position reconciliation
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a single endpoint that returns combined open positions from both IBKR and Schwab alongside our paper tracker so I can verify our internal state matches the brokers.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/brokers/positions returns JSON array of positions: { symbol, quantity, avg_price, current_price, unrealized_pnl, source, reconciled }
source field identifies broker: 'IBKR', 'Schwab', or 'paper_tracker'
reconciled field is true when paper_tracker position matches broker position within 1 contract tolerance
Endpoint gracefully handles IBKR or Schwab being unavailable — returns partial results with source-level error field
engine/routers/brokers_router.py contains the endpoint and is registered in main.py
cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m pytest tests/ -v passes with no regressions

userStories.title: Performance analytics expansion
userStories.description: As a trader, I want the /performance dashboard page to include win rate by hour of day, consecutive wins/losses tracker, and average hold time by signal type so I can identify temporal patterns and signal quality trends.
acceptance_criteria: dashboard/app/performance/page.tsx adds WinRateByHourChart: bar chart showing win rate % for each hour 0-23, data sourced via fetchEngine from GET /api/v1/performance/win-rate-by-hour
dashboard/app/performance/page.tsx adds ConsecutiveStreakTracker panel: shows current streak (wins or losses), longest win streak, longest loss streak
dashboard/app/performance/page.tsx adds AvgHoldTimeBySignal table: rows for LONG/SHORT/HOLD signal types with avg hold time in minutes and trade count
engine/routers/performance_router.py adds GET /api/v1/performance/win-rate-by-hour and GET /api/v1/performance/hold-time-by-signal endpoints
All new data fetched via fetchEngine — no hardcoded URLs
cd dashboard && pnpm run build passes with 0 TypeScript errors
New charts match the Iron Man HUD dark terminal aesthetic of the existing /performance page
